features.name: Fork identity and Vietnamese default language
acceptance_criteria: Launcher label is CTHarness and the main application ID is com.ctharness.app.
A fresh installation starts in Vietnamese; later language choices persist.
Vietnamese resources preserve source keys and format placeholders.
The APK builds and language persistence is checked on device.
tests: Gradle unit tests, assembleDebug and device language smoke test
features.notes: Existing work from the previous session. Static checks and Kotlin compilation passed; APK build and device tests remain unverified. Preserve uncommitted changes and the feat/ctharness-vi branch.

features.name: Localize the app-customization flow
acceptance_criteria: Customization screen labels and the generated chat title use locale resources.
The generated user-visible prompt is available in Vietnamese, English and Chinese.
The prompt uses mrtaix/tianxuan, CTHarness Dev and com.ctharness.app.dev while preserving workflow identifiers.
Resource checks pass and the affected Kotlin code compiles; the flow is smoke-tested on device.
tests: Gradle compilation and device customization-flow smoke test
features.notes: Two localization regressions failed before implementation; a third regression covers the navigation architecture size ratchet. All static contract tests and the Kotlin compilation now pass. Device smoke test is still required; do not mark verified without it.

features.name: Durable in-app link targets
acceptance_criteria: User-facing and installer links resolve to maintained upstream artifacts instead of retired mirrors or another person's repository.
Sponsor list, repository links, release links and update endpoints point at the CTHarness fork.
Installer scripts keep artifact names, checksums and fallbacks valid and pass shell syntax checks.
Live target availability is verified and recorded; unreachable or empty targets are reported, not hidden.
tests: sh -n on each changed installer script
Live GitHub API target checks in .agent/link-target-checks.json
features.notes: Current session scope. Sponsor email, QQ group and third-party mirrors outside the audited scope are unchanged; the fork still has no published release, so update checks and the release-history page remain empty until one is published.

features.name: Remove the logo from app headers
acceptance_criteria: RuntimeTopBar, ChatTopBar and SessionsPaneHeader no longer render TianXuanBrandBadge.
Brand badge remains available for onboarding and the catalog preview where it is not a header.
Kotlin compiles and the headers are smoke-tested on device.
features.notes: A regression test failed on all three headers before the edit and now passes. Kotlin compilation passed. Device appearance not checked.

features.name: Shizuku, queued messages and heavy attachments
acceptance_criteria: A stale RUNNING durable task can be reclaimed so queued messages are not stranded.
A failed queue launch is visible instead of silently dropping the message.
Attachments up to 500 MB can be streamed into the sandbox.
Shizuku waits for a late Binder and gives an actionable manual-grant message after a previous denial.
Behavior is verified on device with all three user-reported symptoms reproduced and resolved.
features.notes: Static regression and Kotlin compilation passed. No device reproduction or APK install was possible in this session, so the three user reports are not yet confirmed fixed in practice.

features.name: Remaining hardcoded user-interface text
acceptance_criteria: Audit remaining UI modules and localize one bounded flow per session.
Do not translate tool IDs, protocol keys, commands or source comments as UI.
Verify affected screens and language switching on device.
tests: Per-flow regression tests, resource compilation and device smoke tests
features.notes: Whole-app localization is not complete. See the progress log for the next audited target.
